problem.description: Express error-handling middleware fails to catch errors thrown in async route handlers when the route uses a sub-router mounted with app.use(). The error propagates as an unhandled promise rejection instead of being caught by the app-level error handler. The fix requires understanding the Router's handle() method in lib/router/index.js, the Layer's handle_request() in lib/router/layer.js, and how errors bubble through nested routers via next(err).
